create.name: Julian Daizan Skinner
create.bio:
Julian Daizan Skinner is a Zen teacher based in London and the founder of Zenways, a lay Zen community and training body he set up in 2007. He gave up a career in the pharmaceutical industry to enter monastic life, trained for many years in Japan and in the West, and holds Dharma transmission in both the Rinzai and Soto lines. In 2007 his teacher, Shinzan Miyamae Roshi, gave him inka, and he is described as the first Englishman to be recognised as a Rinzai roshi. He also trained with Lawrence Noyes in the enlightenment intensive method, which shapes the dyad work used on his retreats.

Daizan's teaching joins seated meditation with movement and energy practice, drawing on the Japanese masters Hakuin and Bankei and on decades of yoga. He leads Sunday sittings and talks at the Zenways dojo in Camberwell and online, residential sesshin, and three-day Breakthrough to Zen retreats in North Wales, and he wrote the curriculum for the Zenways yoga and mindfulness teacher trainings. His books include Practical Zen: Meditation and Beyond and Practical Zen for Health, Wealth and Mindfulness, co-written with Sarah Bladen. On returning from Japan he walked the length of Britain living on alms, from the Isle of Wight to the far north of Scotland.

books.title: Practical Zen: Meditation and Beyond
books.author: Julian Daizan Skinner
books.description: A step-by-step guide to Zen meditation in the Rinzai line of Hakuin and Bankei, taking a beginner from first sitting towards deeper practice. It sets the methods inside the traditional 'two wings of a bird' framework, adds accounts from Western students and closes with source texts in translation.

books.title: Practical Zen for Health, Wealth and Mindfulness
books.author: Julian Daizan Skinner, Sarah Bladen
books.description: Written with Sarah Bladen, this book walks readers through their first hundred days of simple Rinzai body-and-mind practices. Each chapter ends with stories from students, and later sections show how to carry the practice into a busy working life.

courses.title: Sesshin (5-day retreat) – Shinzan Roshi memorial retreat
courses.description: Five days of traditional Zen retreat led by Daizan, with zazen, movement and energy practice, working meditation and one-to-one interviews. This year it marks five years since the death of his teacher, Shinzan Roshi; remote places are open to those who have sat an in-person retreat before.
courses.price: Suggested donation £350–£450 GBP (£200–£300 GBP for Zenways members)

courses.title: Breakthrough to Zen Retreat
courses.description: A three-day intensive at Noddfa in Penmaenmawr, North Wales, built on Shinzan Roshi's group sanzen format and Charles Berner's dyad work. Open to complete beginners as well as people with an established practice.
courses.price: Suggested donation £100–£250 GBP, plus accommodation £300 GBP

courses.title: Breakthrough to Zen Retreat (New Year)
courses.description: The same three-day self-enquiry format held over the turn of the year at Noddfa in North Wales, led by Daizan. Teaching is by donation and meals and rooms are paid separately.
courses.price: Suggested donation £100–£250 GBP, plus accommodation £300 GBP

courses.title: Rohatsu all-night meditation
courses.description: A night of sitting from 9pm to 7am at the Camberwell dojo in London to mark the Buddha's awakening, with private interviews with Daizan or another Zenways teacher. It can also be joined online by donation.

courses.title: Embodied Mindfulness Pathway: Module 1
courses.description: The first stage of a three-module mindfulness teacher training that Daizan designed and still teaches on with the Zenways tutors. It runs as a five-day residential or live online course several times a year and carries IMTA accreditation.

courses.title: 200-Hour Zen Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A Yoga Alliance 200-hour training with Daizan as lead trainer, offered as a two-week residential intensive or over seven weekends with online sessions. It brings Zen practice into how trainees learn to teach.

courses.title: Zen Compassion Plus Teacher Training
courses.description: A five-day training created by Daizan for teachers who want to guide compassion practice, held residentially or online. The next listed dates are in October 2027.

courses.title: Zen Student Membership
courses.description: Membership of the Zenways sangha, given as a monthly donation, with regular group practice in London and online, sanzen meetings with a teacher and reduced prices on retreats.

courses.title: Wake Up and Live
courses.description: Daizan's eight-day audio course on Insight Timer, an introduction to Zen practice in short daily sessions.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Julian Daizan Skinner on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided Zen meditations of around twenty minutes and short Zen talks from Daizan, free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Meeting for Zazen
free_resources.description: Regular group sittings with Daizan or another Zenways teacher at the Camberwell dojo and on Zoom. Newcomers can come several times at no charge before deciding whether to join.
